components.text: Binds a Moon Ring to the one on the centre. While a werewolf wears it, they shift at will and are spared the forced full-moon shift.
The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does) and must be a werewolf. An unbound Moon Ring must be among the items: a ring that is already bound is refused.

Full forms need the Werewolves level the server sets; below it the ring gives half forms.

Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.
